q: What is the carbon footprint of a solar lantern?
title: Solar lantern footprint
short: Add the small solar panel, the battery (lithium-ion or lead-acid), the LED board, the plastic body and packaging. Batteries and the panel usually carry the most. If you claim it replaces a kerosene lamp, report that avoided figure separately from the lantern's own footprint.

ul: Solar cell area or panel watt rating.
Plastic body, LEDs and circuit board.

p: Avoided kerosene use is not a reduction in your inventory. Show it as a separate claim with its assumptions.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol standards, including the Product Standard
